title: Action Queue data
description: The object assigned to window.QUEUE at the top of template/queue.html.

title.description: Page title. A name, two to four words.

done_for_you.description: What the assistant did itself before writing any task. Omit or null if nothing.

id.description: Stable slug. State is keyed on this. NEVER renumber or reuse.

band.description: now = today or tomorrow, nothing over 3 minutes. week = dated inside 7 days.

minutes.description: Honest estimate. 0.5 renders as '30 sec'. Over 15 means split the task.

line.description: ONE sentence. Why now, not what. Inline <b> and <mark class='flag'> allowed.

why.description: Two to four sentences. What breaks if this does not happen.

steps.description: Physical actions only. Each one is something the hand does.

draft.description: Complete copy-ready text. Subject line first where there is one. Never a description of a draft.

note.description: One line. Why it matters: a collision, a thing to bring, something unconfirmed.

url.description: Link to the real calendar event. Create the event first, then link it.
